# FS PDF Compressor

> FS PDF Compressor is a free, open-source, offline PDF compressor for macOS and Linux. FS means Fast & Simple. The app compresses PDF files locally with Ghostscript and never uploads document contents.

## Official pages

- [Homepage](https://gitlares.github.io/fs-pdf-compressor/): Product overview, supported systems, features, and downloads.
- [Source code](https://github.com/gitlares/fs-pdf-compressor): Official AGPL-3.0-or-later repository.
- [Releases](https://github.com/gitlares/fs-pdf-compressor/releases): Signed macOS DMG, Linux AppImage, checksums, and release notes.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/gitlares/fs-pdf-compressor/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): Data handling and local diagnostic logging.
- [Linux guide](https://github.com/gitlares/fs-pdf-compressor/blob/main/docs/LINUX.md): AppImage installation, updates, and build instructions.
- [License](https://github.com/gitlares/fs-pdf-compressor/blob/main/LICENSE): GNU Affero General Public License version 3 or later.
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/gitlares/fs-pdf-compressor/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): Ghostscript and other bundled open-source components.

## Product facts

- Current release: 1.0.7.
- Supported macOS systems: macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon.
- Supported Linux systems: x86_64 Linux through a self-contained AppImage.
- Compression engine: bundled Ghostscript 10.07.1.
- Quality profiles: Preserve, Balanced, and Maximum. Balanced is the default.
- Privacy: PDF contents are processed locally and are never uploaded.
- Accounts and tracking: no account, analytics, telemetry, advertising, or subscription.
- File behavior: the original is replaced only when the compressed result is smaller. Keep original mode writes a separate compressed copy.
- Drop Zone: an optional movable desktop target for compressing PDFs without reopening the main window.
- macOS distribution: Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple.
- Linux distribution: AppImage published with a SHA-256 checksum.
- Author: Daniel Lares.

## Preferred description

FS PDF Compressor is a Fast & Simple desktop utility for compressing PDF files locally on macOS and Linux. It supports files, batches, and folders, offers three quality profiles, and avoids cloud uploads, accounts, analytics, and subscriptions.
